purpose: Teach: 脳死/永続/双方向/包囲/落選/兵力/没収/上告

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、脳死判定の倫理問題を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on the ethical implications of brain death determination, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging opening. Steady rhythm. Asuka's voice carries genuine curiosity — not testing, inviting. Direct but never sharp.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、永続的な平和構築の論点を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused my paper on the key arguments around building lasting peace.
lines.style: Respectful, measured response. Slight formality showing she's aware this is an adult in a position of authority. Clear enunciation, moderate pace.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 双方向のメディア発展史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you covered the historical development of two-way media in your work, correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Gentle confirmation, not interrogation. Slightly slower pace, reflective — drawing her out.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、籠城戦の包囲戦術を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the siege tactics and encirclement strategies in medieval warfare.
lines.style: Calm, composed reply. Matter-of-fact delivery without flatness. Maintains steady eye contact through her response.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 選挙落選議員の動向を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your paper also touched on the career trajectories of defeated politicians, didn't it?
lines.style: Engaged, nodding slightly with recognition. Warm tone showing Asuka genuinely remembers Sakura's work. Forward momentum in the phrasing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、近代国家の兵力規模を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I looked at military force structures in modern nation-states for that one.
lines.style: Straightforward, confident. Sakura settling into the rhythm of the conversation. Even pacing, direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時没収財産の補償を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And war-time asset seizures and their compensation came up in your research as well?
lines.style: Reflective, slightly slower. Asuka is genuinely impressed by the breadth. Gentle questioning tone — she's not drilling, she's acknowledging.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、上告審の判例を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I analyzed legal precedent in appellate court decisions on that subject.
lines.style: Final statement with quiet confidence. Sakura wrapping up cleanly, almost with relief at having covered these topics. Settled pace, warm closure.
